classification.difficultyReason: Substitute algebraic radius and height into the closed-cylinder formula and solve for a positive length.

content.prompt: This cylinder has a surface area of $972\pi\text{ cm}^2$. Work out the value of $x$.

spec.description: Closed upright cylinder with a marked top centre, a centre-to-rim radius dimension and an external height dimension. Decorative grey shading omitted under house style.
spec.mathematics: Radius x cm; height 5x cm. The radius arrow spans only the centre-to-rim segment.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given dimensions are visible; no calculated answer is included.

answer.worked:
$\begin{aligned}972\pi&=2\pi x^2+2\pi x(5x)\\972\pi&=12\pi x^2\\x^2&=81\\x&=9\end{aligned}$

Take the positive root because $x$ represents a length.
